blurb: Guests fish on the Fish Bound IV, a U.S. Coast Guard inspected boat for up to 18 passengers, targeting various species year-round. Trips range from 4-hour inshore trolling and shark fishing to 12-hour offshore fishing. Captain Kane Bounds has over 20 years of experience in Maryland waters.
